question: Sharp Corporation founded location headquarters
markdown:
Sharp Corporation was founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1912 by Tokuji Hayakawa. The company name derives from the Ever-Ready Sharp Pencil invented in 1915. After the 1923 earthquake, operations moved to Osaka. Since 2016, Sharp has been majority-owned by Foxconn.
Sharp Corporation was founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1912 by inventor Tokuji Hayakawa.
Tokuji Hayakawa started a small metalworking shop in Honjo, Tokyo, on September 15, 1912.
The company name comes from the 'Ever-Ready Sharp Pencil,' a mechanical pencil invented by Hayakawa in 1915.
After losing his Tokyo facilities in the 1923 Great Kantō earthquake, Hayakawa moved the business to Osaka, Japan.
Since 2016, Sharp has been majority-owned by the Taiwan-based manufacturing giant Foxconn (Hon Hai Precision Industry).
